text: ok there is the first one. look at what the extrude does on the edge
resolution: Edge extrude 'creates a face between two edges' diagnosed from the follow transcript: the parameterless hotkey stamps a quad at model.radius*0.08 every time, so a later stamp's outer corners land bit-equal on an earlier stamp's vertex stations and the weld rebuild (WELD_Q=1024 cells) silently fuses the new quad onto unrelated geometry — the inspect proved the demo quad's outer edge was a shared interior edge with old triangle 106. Fixed in 3d.zig meshTopoExtrudeEdge: the distance now auto-nudges in 4/1024 steps until the outer corners and their enabled mirror reflections sit clear of every resident vertex's weld class, so an extrude always creates a free boundary edge. Verified by clean build + headless harness run. Editor binary rebuilt at zig-out/bin/editor; dev host needs a restart to pick it up.
